response.description:
Microsoft Foundry introduces a unified platform
for enterprise AI agent observability, security, and governance. The Control
Plane integrates identity, monitoring, and compliance, providing centralized
control, deep observability, and compliance for agent fleets. Entra Agent ID
anchors unified discovery and governance, ensuring agents adhere to enterprise
security and Zero Trust standards.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Microsoft Foundry Control Plane & Entra Agent ID
